A custom shop-survival server with tons to do. No rules except no cheating, play how you want. Full Java + Bedrock crossplay. Just launched, get in early.

⭐ Why Join GolemSMP?

🛡️ No Rules Except No Cheating

Play your way. Fight, build, trade, grief, whatever you want. The only line is cheating.

⚔️ PvP When You Want It

Duel anyone with /pvp in your own gear, or /1v1 for a fair-gear fight. Put bounties on players with /bounty and bet on brawls with /bet.

🏰 Empires

Create an Empire and defend your empire block. Protect it to boost your spawner income, earn a bigger playtime bonus, and unlock a custom nametag.

💰 Economy & Shops

Player shops, spawners, chunk claims, and more to build up your money and base.

🎨 Pixel Art

Use /pixelart to get your own plot in a separate dimension where you can build pixel art safely, no griefing.

⚔️ Custom Gear

Chestplate elytras, emerald gear, and frost tools from the frost store.

🎤 Simple Voice chat

Server works with Simple Voice chat, download the mod to use it --> Here

⚒️ More Features

Mob-spawning control, homes, RTP into the wild, and new stuff added constantly.

📢 Active Discord + Voting

Type /discord in-game to join, vote for rewards, and see updates.

📜 Commands

/pvp, /1v1, /bounty, /bet, /accept, /balance, /pay, /store, /buy, /sell, /list, /order, /deliver, /empire, /spawn, /overworld, /rtp, /tpa, /bringa, /sethome, /home, /delhome, /chunk, /chunktp, /pixelart, /mobspawning, /help, /discord, /mute

Check out https://golemsmp.net/ for the full command list and store.
